# Prevent a recurrence of the 2026-08-26 `/var/gerrit` disk-fill from investigation evidence

## Why
The acute `/var/gerrit` disk-fill incident (`wakeful-ordinary-chicken` / `5a05`) was dominated by one-off investigation evidence written to the Gerrit data volume: `/var/gerrit/rebar-quiet-window-evidence/` held two `epoch-probe-20260826T*` dumps of about 5.2G each (~11G total, 65% of used space). They were reclaimed with operator approval on 2026-08-30, taking `/var/gerrit` from 37% to 15%. Nothing currently prevents similar debris from landing on the data volume again, and the runbook coverage is root-volume-heavy.

This is the carried-over `/var/gerrit` sibling for disk-ceiling epic `endowed-upset-scaup` (`6202-e1c7-c57f-4897`). It is linked to that epic with `relates_to` rather than as a blocking edge so the ADR/scratch/root-accumulator stories remain claimable; the epic acceptance criteria require this ticket to be resolved or explicitly dispositioned before epic close.

## What
Add policy/guarding and runbook coverage so investigation/probe evidence does not accumulate on `/var/gerrit`. Establish the approved evidence/scratch location (prefer the new bounded gate scratch path once S1 lands, or another explicitly capped temporary location) and document how to reclaim `/var/gerrit` data-volume headroom safely.

## Scope
In scope: `/var/gerrit` data-volume runbook, guard/policy for probe evidence paths, optional metric/check for non-`site/` debris, and local tests if code changes are required. Out of scope: root-volume Docker/journald/tmp/container caps and gate scratch EBS provisioning, which are tracked by sibling stories under `endowed-upset-scaup`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Investigation/probe output does not land on the Gerrit data volume (`/var/gerrit`) without an explicit, bounded, documented exception.
- [ ] A guard, check, or loud failure path prevents or flags probe output under `/var/gerrit` before it can silently accumulate.
- [ ] Probe artifacts are bounded at spawn or stored under a capped scratch location so they self-clean rather than accumulate.
- [ ] `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md` documents `/var/gerrit` data-disk reclaim/headroom diagnosis and safe remediation, not only root-volume Docker prunes.
- [ ] Optional non-`site/` `/var/gerrit` debris metric/alarm is either implemented or explicitly rejected with rationale in the ticket/runbook.
- [ ] Portability criterion: any guard/check uses host-level scripts/runbooks and local validation, not a GitHub-only CI trigger.

## Notes / scope boundary
The slower data-disk growth driver from tickets-branch enrichment fan-out/blob-inclusive store remains separate work tracked by `4520`/`536b`/`0754`; do not duplicate that here.
